name: capstone-project
description: A blockchain-backed, AI-powered identity verification system integrated into a student portal. This capstone project ensures academic integrity for online examinations through real-time liveness detection, document verification, and immutable verification records.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n backend,frontend,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "cd ai-service && .\venv\Scripts\python.exe app.py"
